sg1.intro: The main Scotch Gambit: meet Bb4+ with Bd2, win the pawn back, and castle.
notes: e4 takes space in the centre and opens lines for the bishop and queen.
e5 meets White in the centre and opens a path for the dark-squared bishop.
Nf3 develops a knight towards the centre and attacks the pawn on e5.
Nc6 develops a knight and defends the pawn on e5.
d4 attacks the pawn on e5 straight away.
exd4 takes the pawn on d4. Black accepts the offer and clears a pawn out of the centre.
Bc4 aims at f7, Black's weak spot.
Bc5 develops the dark-squared bishop and defends the pawn on d4.
c3 attacks the pawn on d4. White is offering a gambit pawn.
Nf6 develops a knight towards the centre and attacks the pawn on e4.
cxd4 takes the pawn on d4 and attacks the bishop on c5.
Bb4+ moves the bishop to b4 and gives check.
Bd2 develops the dark-squared bishop and attacks the bishop on b4.
Bxd2+ takes the bishop on d2 and gives check.
Nbxd2 recaptures the bishop on d2 and develops a knight.
d5 attacks the bishop on c4 and the pawn on e4. Black challenges the centre and that bishop together.
exd5 takes the pawn on d5 and attacks the knight on c6.
Nxd5 recaptures the pawn on d5. The knight replaces the pawn in the centre.
O-O castles the king to safety and brings a rook towards the centre.
O-O castles the black king to safety and brings a rook towards the centre.
